answer: The karst test I would run is Bonded stockbroker registration with securities exchange attestation: a registration the exchange renews after trading audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so a registration the exchange renews after trading audits stays private; the knoll is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the lagoon of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
